conviction_note: Balanced evidence. On the positive side: a company guide of 'sequentially stronger earnings beginning in 3Q26', a sell-side bar that Itau BBA, XP and BTG have all cut (Itau now ~R$200m, flat on 2Q26's tax-assisted R$200.3m), Q3 funding relief from 125bp of Selic cuts, a direct INSS peer (Mercantil) reporting a September origination recovery, a 3m-share buyback against a 27.6m Class A float, and a stock still about 30% below its pre-election close at under 4x 2027 earnings (XP). On the negative side: every print since the IPO has been sold (4Q25 -6.1% intraday, 1Q26 down after an Itau downgrade, 2Q26 -7.6% day one and -13.7% on the week), the forward rate path turned worse after the election (Copom held at 13.75% on 2026-11-04, Focus 2027 Selic up to 12.50% from 11.75%), the tax rate is normalising, and opex is running hot. Inter and Nubank report inside the same window. p_up 52 on abs 8 gives +0.32. The findings sum to +0.8, close to it and positive; the gap is small because the sign is near a coin flip, not because I shrank anything.
bar: Disputed and thin. EPS aggregators disagree: TipRanks $0.28 (https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/agbk/earnings) against Public.com $0.46 (https://public.com/stocks/agbk/earnings), and the share counts behind them do not reconcile (AAII 27.6m Class A, Equibles 261m total). The usable bar is BRL net income: Itau BBA ~R$200m and ROE 17% for 3Q26, 'below its previous estimate' (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/resultados-financeiros/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/, 2026-11-03). That is one broker, against 2Q26 IFRS net income of R$200.3m, which included an ~R$85m IPO-related tax credit (pre-tax only R$115m). The company's qualitative guide is 'sequentially stronger earnings beginning in the third quarter' (2Q26 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2081206/000129281426004070/ex99-1.htm). The bar is not sourced to a company number or to two agreeing estimates, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 1,636,720 shares at the 2026-10-30 settlement, up 789,326 from the prior period (roughly doubled after the election crash), 2.13 days to cover. That is about 5.9% of the ~27.6m Class A shares (AAII) and 0.6% of all shares outstanding (Equibles). Peak was 2.92m on 2026-05-29. Source: https://equibles.com/stocks/agbk/shortinterest (read 2026-11-11). It is building but not crowded. No listed options (baseline: no_options_market), so there is no skew or priced lean. Tape: -25.9% over 20 days, almost all of it the 2026-10-26 Brazil election crash (AGBK -37.4% that day, alongside XP -48%, PICS -36%, INTR -35%), then +7.8% over 5 days into the print. 52-week low $4.43, -55.6% from the high.

findings.finding: Agi's 2Q26 release (filed 2026-08-05) guides to 'sequentially stronger earnings beginning in the third quarter' with 'a more pronounced financial contribution in the fourth quarter', margin recovery as higher-yielding vintages mature, better efficiency, and Agi+ fee revenue from 3Q26. The 2Q26 base is IFRS net income of R$200.3m, pre-tax ~R$115m, NIM 11.9%, efficiency 48.9%. The only sourced bar (Itau BBA ~R$200m) is roughly flat on that headline, so the company has guided above or at the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2Q26: pre-tax profit -47% q/q against expectations of growth; stock -7.56% day one (baseline 2026-08-05) and -13.7% on the week (finsiders). 4Q25: -6.1% intraday on weak origination and NPL. The name has not yet been paid for an in-line or better quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is public, so the market already holds it. It lands inside what the company guided, so it is sized toward 0. The only reason it is not 0 is that the sell-side bar was cut below the guide's direction: Itau sits at ~R$200m, flat, not 'stronger'. If the market fully believed the guide, the stock would not trade under 4x 2027 earnings (XP).
findings.independence: Itau BBA expects the result to improve vs 2Q26 on the INSS consignado recovery and service revenue (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/resultados-financeiros/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/).

findings.finding: The sell-side bar has been cut into the print. Itau BBA cut 2026 profit by 5% and 2027 by 9%, with 3Q26 ~R$200m, below its prior estimate. XP (2026-10-28) cut 2027 recurring profit by 3%, keeps Buy with a $10 target and expects INSS consignado to normalise from 4T26. BTG cut EPS 12% for 2026 and 8% for 2027. A lowered bar against a company guide of sequential improvement makes a headline beat more likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior case of the bar being cut into a print on this name. In 2Q26 the bar was too high (Itau: 'second consecutive quarter with a more pronounced deviation from our estimates') and the stock fell.
findings.why_not_priced: The cuts are public, but USD EPS aggregators still disagree ($0.28 against $0.46). That suggests stale bars sit in the aggregators even where the brokers have cut. Had the market re-anchored to a lowered bar, the 5-day +7.8% bounce would read as positioning into a beat, and it is not clearly that.
findings.independence: https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/agibank-despenca-760-e-tem-a-pior-semana-entre-fintechs-nos-eua/ (2026-11-06, Itau cut). The BTG cut is from search snippet only.

findings.finding: Q3 funding relief. The Selic was cut five times between March and September 2026, from 15% to 13.75%. Agibank funds at floating CDI spreads (letras financeiras at CDI+0.60/0.75% in June 2026, FIDC III at CDI+1.05% on 2026-10-01) while its INSS book is fixed-rate under a 1.85%/month cap. Lower average CDI in Q3 should widen NIM, which management guided would recover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2Q26 NIM was 11.9% with pre-tax down sharply, and the stock fell. There is no case yet of a NIM beat being rewarded.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission that the company has not quantified for Q3, so it is a small proxy finding. It sits inside the guided margin recovery. Brokers include it in their estimates.
findings.independence: Funding terms are from company documents: FIDC III 6-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2081206/000129281426004827/ex99-1.htm and the June letras financeiras https://www.latamfintech.co/articles/neobanco-brasileno-agibank-capta-us-97-4-millones-en-letras-financieras-para-reforzar-su-estrategia-de-crecimiento.

findings.finding: The forward rate path turned against the funding model after Lula's re-election on 2026-10-25. Copom stopped the cutting cycle at 13.75% on 2026-11-04 (39 of 75 houses had expected a cut). Focus 2027 Selic rose to 12.50% from 11.75% and 2028 to 11% from 10%, and BRL weakened from ~5.0 to ~5.5. Management will be asked about 4Q26/2027 NIM on the call, and USD-translated forward EPS falls about 10% on FX alone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior forward-rate guide from this company. The sector repriced -17% to -48% on 2026-10-26 on this same macro shift.
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it is priced: the stock fell 37% on 2026-10-26. What may not be priced is management confirming a slower NIM recovery or pushing the 2027 recovery out again (finsiders on 2026-08-14 already had it moved to 2027), because the broker cuts so far are 3-9% on 2027 while the stock fell ~35%.
findings.independence: Election crash moves: https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/mercado-chora-vitoria-de-lula-e-acoes-de-fintechs-afundam-nos-eua-xp-despenca-51/. This shares the Copom document with the Q3 funding-relief finding but lands on a different line (forward guide vs reported quarter).

findings.finding: The INSS consignado margin returned to 45% from 40% when MP 1.355/2026 lapsed (reported 2026-09-17/09-28). Per BTG, Agibank called this positive and expects it to unlock additional origination capacity in its main product. The catch: the two 5% card slices are frozen by the TCU, so the personal-loan cap stays at 35%, and experts expect the first wave to be portability and refinancing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Regulatory INSS news has moved this name before: the Dec-2025 INSS suspension drove a weak 4Q25 and a -6.1% reaction. No case of positive regulatory news at a print.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public since mid-September and partly priced. Management may quantify October origination on the call, which nobody has yet. The finding's own caveat (loan margin unchanged at 35%) cuts its size.

findings.finding: Direct INSS-payroll peer Banco Mercantil reported 3T26 net income of R$279.4m (+10% y/y, 16th consecutive record) after Agibank last spoke. Its INSS consignado book was R$15.6bn (+15%) and private payroll R$3.0bn (+163%), and it said INSS origination recovered in September, pointing to a safer 4T26 environment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this name of a peer read-through measured at a print.
findings.source_date: 2026-11 (snippet_only; page returned 403, date taken from the 3T26 reporting season)
findings.why_not_priced: A B3 mid-cap's print is not followed by the NYSE holders of AGBK. If it had been read across, the sell-side would not still be cutting Agibank's 2026 numbers on 'blocked concessions' (Itau, 2026-11-03/06). It is a counterparty-level proxy, sized small.
findings.independence: XP (2026-10-28) expects INSS consignado normalisation from 4T26, and Itau expects Q3 to improve on the INSS consignado recovery (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/resultados-financeiros/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/).

findings.finding: Peer BMG reported 3T26 recurring net income of R$141m, down from R$157m in 2T26, with new INSS consignado card issuance suspended since late April 2026. Agibank's card exposure is negligible (credit cards R$45m of a R$37.1bn book at 2Q26), so the read-across is mostly the INSS environment, not the card freeze.
findings.why_not_priced: Same as the Mercantil finding: B3 peer prints are not followed by AGBK holders. Net of Agibank's tiny card book, it is close to 0.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-27 the board approved a buyback of up to 3m Class A shares, open market or 10b5-1, through 2027-10-27. That is about 11% of the ~27.6m Class A shares outstanding at about $5.3 (~$16m). Execution to date is undisclosed and may be reported on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On announcement day (2026-10-27, bmo) the stock rose +3.17% (baseline), the day after the -37% crash.
findings.why_not_priced: The announcement is priced. What is not priced is how much has been bought (the company has no obligation to buy) and whether a 10b5-1 plan is buying through the print window, which on a $3m/day name (574k shares x $5.3) is material bid support.
findings.independence: Lumina (linked to board member Daniel Goldberg) raised its stake from 5% to 7% (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/bancos-digitais/agibank-pisa-no-acelerador-do-inss-mas-trava-no-freio-dos-custos/, 2026-08-14).

findings.finding: The stock is still ~30% below its pre-election close ($7.58 on 2026-10-23 against $5.33 now) after the 2026-10-26 sector crash (AGBK -37.4%). XP puts it under 4x expected 2027 earnings, while broker earnings cuts since are 3-12%. Short interest roughly doubled to 1.64m shares (2.1 days to cover) at the 2026-10-30 settlement. An in-line print with a steady guide gives a relief mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print came after a macro crash. After the crash: +3.17% on 2026-10-27, -7.6% in the week of 2026-11-02, +7.8% over the last 5 days.
findings.why_not_priced: The discount is the market's price for Brazil fiscal and rate risk, so it is partly a priced view, not a mistake. The relief case needs a company-level reason, and a print is the first one since the crash. Short interest is building but not crowded, so this is sized small.

findings.finding: This name has sold every print since its February 2026 IPO. 4Q25 (released 2026-03-23): -6.1% intraday, -10% at the open. 1Q26 (released 2026-05-05): up 6-7% after hours, then led fintech losers on 2026-05-08, with an Itau downgrade and target cut. 2Q26 (released 2026-08-04 amc): -7.56% day one and -13.7% on the week.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This finding is the reaction history, rebuilt from confirmed releases because the baseline's 8-day cadence history is unusable.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a reaction pattern, not a fact the price holds. The three prior prints each had a real miss (origination, NPL, pre-tax), so the pattern may reflect bad quarters rather than a habit of selling beats. That is why this is sized small.

findings.finding: Earnings quality is at risk from tax. The 2Q26 effective tax rate was -74.2%, with an ~R$85m tax credit tied to IPO proceeds supporting R$200.3m net income on R$115m pre-tax. Itau BBA says the effective rate should normalise upward and could become a tax expense as early as 4Q26. A headline beat flattered by tax would be discounted, and a tax-driven headline miss is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2Q26: headline net income rose 7.4% q/q on the tax credit while pre-tax fell 47%. The stock fell 7.6%: the market traded pre-tax, not the headline.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a below-the-line item and sized as a fraction. The risk is that the ~R$200m headline bar embeds a tax benefit that shrinks.

findings.finding: Costs and credit are running hot. 2Q26 admin expenses were R$769m (+21% q/q, 12% above Itau's forecast) and efficiency worsened from 43.2% to 48.9%. Itau's 3Q26 preview says cost of risk is still high and expenses weigh. A Santos FC master shirt sponsorship began 2026-10-16 (a 4Q26 cost). Private payroll peers report rising NPL (Inter guided NPL up in 3T26; PicPay NPL90 9.8% from 8.9%), though Agibank's private payroll is only R$1.4bn (3.8% of the book) and its 2Q26 NPL90 was 3.3% with 182.6% coverage.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2Q26: opex 12% above estimates and the stock -7.6%. 4Q25: NPL90 up 1.1pp to 3.7% and the stock -6.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is in Itau's lowered number, so mostly priced. Sized net of the 96% of the book that is INSS, secured or unsecured personal rather than private payroll.
findings.independence: 2Q26 opex detail: https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/bancos-digitais/agibank-pisa-no-acelerador-do-inss-mas-trava-no-freio-dos-custos/. Sponsorship: https://www.letsmoney.com.br/noticias/agibank-patrocinador-master-santos/. Shares the 2026-11-03 finsiders document with the bar-cut finding but on a different line.

outside_window.finding: Copom's next meeting, 2026-12-08/09, decides whether the Selic path resumes cuts (Focus year-end 13.50%). That is the funding-cost driver for 4Q26/2027.

The Pillar 3 report for 202609 (the 202606 edition was created 2026-08-31, about 60 days after quarter end) would show Banco Agibank's capital and exposures for September. Expected around end of November.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The -25.9% 20-day run-up is a sector-wide election crash, not company disappointment, and the slight positive lean (lowered bar, buyback, depressed multiple) cuts against the run-up. It is offset by a reaction history of every print being sold, so p_up sits at 52.
lessons_applied: Rule 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the INSS 45%-margin finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2, because its own text says the personal-loan cap stays at 35% while the TCU freezes the card slices.
Rule 2 (one-offs as one-offs): the tax-normalisation finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2 as a below-the-line item with no stated path to the guide.
Rule 6 (bar disputed: TipRanks $0.28 vs Public $0.46, one broker in BRL): every finding already capped below 1 point; no further change.
Rule 1 / last section (rebuild reaction history from confirmed releases): already done for the 'every print sold' finding; size kept.
Net: impact_sum unchanged at +0.8 (the two edits offset); abs_move 8 and p_up 52 unchanged.
